title.en: In the absence of adverse events, resume fluids on day 1, soft diet on day 3, and normal diet on day 7 post-POEM.

statement.en: In the absence of adverse events, resume fluids on day 1, soft diet on day 3, and normal diet on day 7 post-POEM.

commentary.en: The initial studies of POEM suggested a liquid diet on the day after the POEM procedure, followed by a soft diet on post-POEM day 3, with resumption of a normal diet on post-POEM day 4 [112]. Owing to the lack of evidence, the panel proposal is based on an internal Delphi consensus.
